units.source_text: 当然，我做梦也没想到十年后会将这些日记作为作品发表。

en.t: Of course, I never dreamed that ten years later I would publish these diaries as a literary work.

units.source_text: 总之，之所以能作为作品读下去，大概因为是写生式的缘故，而不是早熟的文才。

en.t: In short, if they can be read as a work at all, it is probably because they are written in a sketchlike style, not because of any precocious literary talent.

units.source_text: 为了将祖父的话速记下来，

en.t: In order to take down my grandfather's words in shorthand,

units.source_text: 我没有工夫去修饰文章，字迹也十分潦草，后来有些字都认不出来了。

en.t: I had no time to polish the writing, and my handwriting was very sloppy; later, I could no longer make out some of the characters.
